notes.title: BIG DEMO UPDATE
notes.content:
Get ready to spice up your culinary adventure with the sizzling new update for Let's Cook Together 2 on Steam! 

Enjoy Brand New Features Added to Our Game:


 Added support for Simplified Chinese.
 Added Party Mode.
 Added achievements and support for Steam achievements (note: achievements do not work in the demo - only in the full version).

notes.title: MASSIVE DEMO UPDATE!!!!!
notes.content:
Hungry for a Taste of the Kitchen Action?
Get ready to fire up your stoves because the Let's Cook Together 2 demo has just received a massive update! 🍳

Enjoy Brand New Features Added to Our Game:

 Drone Battles Brace yourself and try to survive the attacks of Nutri Inc drone strikes aimed directly at the Prodigy (fly into any of the locked regions to try it out)!
 Unlockable Streamer Mode If you want to engage your community in playing and enjoying a cooking game with you, look no further, as the streamer mode is now unlockable in our game!
 NutriLand Added Well, you won't be able to play it in the demo, but we've added a fourth cuisine in which you'll cook... Nutripaste!
 Unlockable Level Editor After beating the demo, try building your own levels! 🎉
 General Upgrades How about some extra help in the great fight against the evil food corporation? Check out the massive new selection of enhancements which, once purchased, work across all cuisines.
 All Chefs are Unlockable from the Start If you wanted to try the skills of the additional chefs... now you can. New chefs with their unique skills can be purchased at the very start of the game, but it'll cost you some coins!
 Chefs can now Jump To be honest, it does not provide any additional help during the game, but, boy, it does look cool!
 Bug Fixes As always, we focus on taking care of some nasty bugs that were trying to ruin the fun of playing Let's Cook Together 2.

notes.title: DEMO UPDATE!
notes.content:
Let's Cook Together 2 Demo Update

Hello, aspiring chefs and culinary enthusiasts! We're delighted to present a sizzling new update to the "Let's Cook Together 2" Demo. Your appetite for cooking challenges has been heard, and we've been busy cooking up some exciting improvements. Let's dive into what's simmering in the kitchen:

Cutscenes
Get ready to immerse yourselves into culinary repertoire with a selection of delectable new cutscenes! From shivering scenes from the future, to chill stories about cooking, everyone will find something to grind their gears!

Level editor
That's right - you can create your own levels and play them. In the demo you can only create levels for the Polish cuisine and you cannot share them with the community - that is reserved for the full version when it comes.

Optimized level layouts
We made sure, that while playing our game, everyone will be able to do their job, have fun, and cook. We follow the principle widely known in the internet: 'Let Them Cook!!!'!

New music
The arsenal of music was extended with the climatic music of MINDSTEELNESS

Factory levels
We heard you. We heard you loud and clear! Factory levels, more factory levels...

Experimental levels
... or maybe it was experimental levels? To be honest, who hates those hard challenges (the spawn of our graphic designer imagination)? More of them! Release the hard puzzles on people!!!!!

Better UI
We have updated many menus, buttons, and navigation elements to provide a clutter-free cooking environment.

Bug Fixes and Performance Optimization
We've tackled pesky bugs and fine-tuned the game's performance for a more enjoyable cooking journey.

Proper credits
We have updated the credits to include all the wonderful people who made it possible for LCT2 be created.

Bon appétit!

notes.title: Welcome to Poland - DEMO UPDATE
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42127725/6906f9234630705f02da323fc7dcded1c3d4fb46.png
Arrivederci, Italy!
With this update, we're bringing you Poland. Those of you who follow our Twitch streams could've seen it coming. Poland - our homeland - will be the first country you'll visit in Let's Cook Together 2, and is now the only country you'll visit in the demo.

This changes a lot
If you thought we simply swapped the map asset, think again. Poland is not only an entirely new country – it's a totally different experience. You can now enjoy:

 Singleplayer mode. That's right, even though Let's Cook Together 2 is still a co-op game at its heart, it's also super inclusive! 
 Polish – the first language to join Let's Cook Together 2's multilingual world. 
 New recipes (100% POLISH CERTIFIED), upgrades and characters.
 A flurry of fast-paced levels.
 Fresh Battle arenas.
 Updated game mechanics and visual effects.
 Story-driven backgrounds (it's a thing, trust us).
 ...and a mysterious Level Editor option, whaaaa?

You'll immediately taste the difference. And if it's is your first time playing, then well – welcome to Poland! Can't wait for you to max this one out.

notes.title: Demo update - Chaos Mode now available!
notes.content:
Enter the Chaos
[previewyoutube=rrNmlyhnDWU;full][/previewyoutube]
Update 0.4 brings the intense, unpredictable, and long-awaited Chaos Mode to Let's Cook Together 2! From inverted controls and spontaneous teleportation to invisibility and strobe lights, try to survive as the kitchens you thought you knew suddenly turn into crazy, mind-boggling traps.

Try it in the demo now:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1637400/Lets_Cook_Together_2/

Raise your hand
With Chaos Mode, the "Gimme!" mechanic makes an introduction as well. Use it for signaling your position to other players. Just make sure you can catch whatever's coming your way.

Also in the update: 
- More intuitive tutorial;
- New teleportation effects;
- Better Prodigy controls;
and more!

Can't wait for your feedback on this one. Good luck! 

Full changelog:

New game mode: Chaos Mode. Look for levels with antenna on the map and get a gold medal in them to unlock Chaos Mode.
Added the "Gimme!" move - press B to notify other players where your character is on the screen (very useful in 3-4 player game)
Added the New Stuff system - the camera now zooms in on new appliances and ingredients and shows a short description. This should make the starting experience even more intuitive.
Added the New Content Popup – when entering the map the game now sometime shows a popup with newly-unlocked content (new chefs, new upgrades, new game modes, etc.)
Upgraded the project to the newest version of Unity which gave us new possibilities (but also introduced new bugs to deal with)
Much nicer chef teleportation effect (we created a custom shader for that and this alone required the Unity upgrade)
Much nicer wall transparency effect (which we are very proud of as getting this kind of things set up in a 2D game is not an easy task)
Retweaked the chef => appliances detection system - it should now guess the players intentions much better
Chefs look much better on the chef selection screen (custom graphics for each character by Johan)
Cleaning stains now has it's own small UI to show the progress o cleaning
Added a "Resume" button in the Pause Menu
Added a "Change Chefs" button in the Pause Menu - its a shortcut to use if you want to change chefs or add new players quickly
Added a few new sound effects
Restored the fire effect on the stove (apparently it was broken in the project for the past 6 months)
Better progress UI colors - it should now be more clear when an appliance has finished its work
Moving around the map should now be more intuitive (many small but important changes there)
Added a Pause Menu on the map
You can now set the vibration strength in the settings or switch them off completely
The upgrades shop will now show only the appliances that you know and their order is more intuitive
The upgrades shop will now work properly on wide-screens
Many small optimizations for the Level Editor

notes.title: Battle mode just dropped
notes.content:
This is intense
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42127725/5f1d4e8c83667e879ebaaa6b669bd0d9893937eb.png
You can't always cooperate, can you? For those of you who like to spice things up, we've just the (in)famous Battle mode. And it's beyond intense! 

Play against each other (1v1 or 2v2) in 3 Battle types:

 Economy – the player (or team) to earn the most coins wins. Watch out for combos! 
 Race – beat one another to serve all the dishes.
 Tiebreak – a possibly endless mode in which you need to be 2 orders ahead of your opponent to win. 

And the best thing? It's all included in the free demo – along the many Adventure and Experimental Levels. 

Check out us testing Battle mode out on Twitch last evening -- and have fun yourselves!

notes.title: Don't get burned! Update 0.2.6 available
notes.content:
Hi Beta Chefs, we cooked you an update!

After receiving tremendous amount of spot-on feedback on our Discord server (shout out, guys!), we introduced a handful of new features and tweaks to Let's Cook Together 2. Here's a rundown:

Don't get burned!
New burn mechanic puts some pressure on the serving side of gameplay. No more strolling around with hot meals – because now they're HOT, for real. So don't get too attached or they'll [strike]bite[/strike] burn. See how it works:
[previewyoutube=zh31ymjBAl8;full][/previewyoutube]

Through the wall
It's now easier to see which walls are blocking your food's path when serving/throwing. We're still tweaking the wall system, and with this change, we made things a bit more intuitive. 

Other notable changes
We have also:

 Made a few mechanics less challenging across all difficulty levels,
 By popular demand - Introduced custom key bindings for those of you playing on keyboard,
 Added resolution selection,
 Added juicer sound effects. 


Thanks again for all the feedback you provided on Discord and in Steam Discussions. See you in a while!

notes.title: Let's Cook Together 2 Roadmap – see what the future holds
notes.content:
Check out Let's Cook Together 2 Roadmap
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42127725/210a90e031f33239fbbdccded9ab9640723a422e.png

So, what does all of this mean? Here are some details for Q2. 

Closed beta
With the closed beta, you get the chance to play the game before anybody else – for free. The goal of the beta for us is to listen closely to you, the player, to help create the best experience possible. It drops really soon. Click here to sign up:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42127725/2c6e9db7d6b0436b51b2001d5ed725890695bfe1.png

Once the beta starts, you feedback will be invaluable. So join our Discord to share your thoughts:
 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42127725/035d8562a14a9e803a0889033c398a7c7ab921f2.png

Battle mode
One of the most beloved features of Let's Cook Together, Battle mode is making a return in Let's Cook Together 2. Beat anybody you play against at the game of cooking food as fast and as smartly as possible. Whoever serves the most dishes, wins! 

More levels and mechanics
The map grows bigger and denser each day, so expect to race time in dozens of new levels before the game leaves the beta! We're talking about new kitchen layouts, new appliances, upgrades, and different character perks and cooking mechanics.

Comfy interior for the spaceship
In Let's Cook Together 2, you travel the world onboard the Prodigy spaceship. Remnant of a distant past, it's your team's hub, playground, HQ, main menu, cafeteria, and the only safe means of transportation. So of course it has to be cool and chill and comfy. Once the interior is all done and decorated, you'll love to hang out in there!

Wishlist and follow to stay updated
Don't forget to wishlist Let's Cook Together 2!

More announcements coming soon 👀

notes.title: Let's Cook Together 2 is Coming Soon – Wishlist Now!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=-yt8G13ZVSA;full][/previewyoutube]
Let's Cook Together 2 is coming soon to Steam, and a Closed Beta is right around the corner!
Set off on a cooperative journey to save the planet and its food from Nutri Inc. – a tyrannical food government seeking to turn Earth into a dry, tasteless dystopia. Wishlist now if you haven't!

Click to sign up for Closed Beta:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42127725/2c6e9db7d6b0436b51b2001d5ed725890695bfe1.png

Let's Cook Together 2 builds on the idea and the mechanics that gave birth to its predecessor, but takes them to new heights. Literally. Onboard the Prodigy spaceship, you and your team lead a revolution to overthrow Nutri Inc, a bunch of crazy zero waste maniacs controlling the world. How? By the power of cooking and cooperation, of course! 

But there's much more to it. Let's Cook Together 2 is the most ambitious project we've ever worked on, all the way from story and design to execturion. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42127725/68cd5ebc9d6aa9542fccc753af0a67425c1eaacc.jpg

Here's what you're in for:

 From Italy to Japan, free-roam the world and liberate regions, countries and landmarks all around the globe.
 Visit dozens of challenging, wildly arranged kitchens to put your co-op skills to the test.
 Enjoy tons of new mechanics. Cleaning, bumping into each other, operating futuristic appliances and much more are here to make each level feel unique.
 Choose the right chef for the job. Each of the characters now has different perks that may make or break the experience.
 Get to know your team and feel the bitter taste of the future, as a mature, full-blown plot is making a debut.
 And much more to come. 

We're extremly excited to share more news with you in the near future. Can't wait for you to save taste from the tasteless!
